reason: A GitHub MCP workbench that exposes repository, issue, pull request, review, search, and authentication tools to coding agents, including operations that modify GitHub resources and merge pull requests.

summaries.zh: 通过 MCP 为编码智能体提供 GitHub 仓库、Issue、Pull Request、代码审查、搜索和认证操作。
summaries.en: An MCP-based GitHub workbench that gives coding agents tools for repository, issue, pull request, code review, search, and authentication tasks.

capabilities: Queries GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, reviews, and code search
Creates and edits issues and pull requests
Posts issue or pull-request comments and submits code reviews
Merges pull requests and can delete source branches as part of merging
Authenticates with GitHub using a personal access token or OAuth device flow
